verdict.rationale: FireHydrant documents Runbooks as its automation engine. They attach to incidents automatically: a Default Runbook attaches to every incident, and other runbooks evaluate their conditions whenever an incident is declared. Documented steps include creating a Slack channel, starting a Zoom meeting, assigning roles and adding task lists, plus a send-a-webhook step that can call internal systems such as rollback tooling. Missing for 10: diagnostics as a runbook action are only implied through the generic webhook step rather than documented, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of runbook automation.
